name: King of h3dm2
description: A single-elimination tournament on h3dm_nc: best-of-1 matches up to the 1/16 finals, then best-of-3 matches. From the 1/16 finals the starting heroes are drawn by a hero roulette.
additional_rules: Special victory: a player who captures the opponent's starting town and builds a Capitol wins the game, and in a best-of-3 the whole match. Each player has one subjective restart on turn 111, and there is no early-encounter restart. By explicit agreement of both players the timer can be changed, up to 21:00+08:30+02:00, and so can the length of simultaneous turns. Before the 1/16 finals the winner of the color bid bans 0 to 3 starting heroes of the drawn town, the loser picks a hero first and the winner picks one of the others
